about.text: A type of soft, white cheese (queso fresco) most commonly associated with Venezuelan cuisine. Pictured is a cachapa with queso de mano.

sources.text: fresh, hand-shaped Venezuelan cheese; curd worked in hot water, mozzarella-like, built up in layers

facts.v: Curd fermented to the cuajada a punto stage, then stretched into threads in water at about 90 °C
